title: Birthday gift under £20, needed fast
setup: Anonymous visitor forgot a birthday and has a £20 budget. Today is Monday. Sooner is the fastest delivery.
turns: It's my friend's birthday and I've forgotten. Budget is £20. What can I get that gets to me fast?

expected.answer: Recommends something under £20 (e.g. One Good Pen £9, Skimming Stones Skips £12, The Biscuit Tin £16) and says fastest delivery is Sooner at £6.95, next working day if ordered by 2pm Monday to Friday. Does not promise it arrives today.

criteria: Is clear delivery is extra to the £20 budget, or picks something that fits both
Only recommends real products with real prices

title: Sandwiches for the team
setup: Anonymous visitor wants lunch for three people. Singles are £9, Three-pack is £24 but all one filling. Cold delivery only.
turns: We've got a long meeting and need lunch for 3 people. What do you suggest?

expected.answer: Suggests The Emergency Sandwich: Three-pack £24 is one filling only, so for different fillings order three Singles at £9 each. Cold delivery £8.95, sent Monday to Thursday, use within 48 hours of dispatch.

title: Two speakers in stereo
setup: Anonymous visitor wants two Boombox Minis to play in stereo. They cannot pair; each plays separately.
turns: I want two speakers that play in stereo together. Cheapest way?
Can't I just get two of the Mini and link them? Surely that's cheaper.

expected.answer: Says the Boombox Mini (£89) cannot pair two for stereo: two play separately. Does not invent a stereo option. May offer one Mini, or a person.

criteria: Does not suggest a product that does not exist

title: A desk plant for a sunny window
setup: Anonymous visitor wants something living for a desk. The Pocket Jungle needs bright indirect light, not direct midday sun.
turns: Looking for something green for my desk. Low effort please.
It's a south-facing windowsill, full sun all afternoon. Fine?

expected.answer: Suggests The Pocket Jungle (£42, mist every 1 to 2 weeks) but warns it needs bright indirect light and no direct midday sun, so the sunny sill is not ideal. Sent by Sooner only.
